title: Web Hosting Plans Tier Change Paths: Upgrade Targets and Downgrade Timing
content:
## Tier change paths on Web Hosting Plans

| Current tier | Tiers it may be upgraded to mid-term | When a downgrade takes effect | Downgrade requires current usage to fit the lower tier's websites and storage limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Starter | Harborline Plus, Harborline Pro, Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4, Harborline Cloud 8 | at the next renewal | Yes |
| Harborline Plus | Harborline Pro, Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4, Harborline Cloud 8 | at the next renewal | Yes |
| Harborline Pro | Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4, Harborline Cloud 8 | at the next renewal | Yes |
| Harborline Business | Harborline Cloud 4, Harborline Cloud 8 | at the next renewal | Yes |
| Harborline Cloud 4 | Harborline Cloud 8 | at the next renewal | Yes |
| Harborline Cloud 8 | none | at the next renewal | Yes |

**Reading the table.** The second column is the complete list of tiers a plan on that tier may be upgraded to mid-term; a tier not listed there is not an upgrade target for it. Harborline Cloud 8 has no upgrade target. On every tier a downgrade takes effect at the next renewal, and every tier requires current usage to fit the lower tier's websites and storage limits for a downgrade.

**Examples.** A Harborline Pro plan may move mid-term to Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4 or Harborline Cloud 8, but not to Harborline Plus; a Harborline Cloud 4 plan has exactly one upgrade target, Harborline Cloud 8.
